### 💡 Feature Overview
A clear and concise description of the suggested feature or capability.

### 🎯 Problem Statement
What problem does this solve for rural artisans or local sellers? (e.g. *Artisans struggle with estimating packaging weights...*)

### 🛠️ Proposed Solution & Modality
Which zero-typing modality should handle this?
- [ ] **Vision**: Viewfinder guidance, automatic defect detection, dimension estimate
- [ ] **Voice**: Localized dialect anchor questions, voice commands
- [ ] **Tactile UI**: Quick selector cards, corridor adjustments
- [ ] **ONDC Protocol**: Schema extension, logistics provider integration

### 🌐 Indic Language / Regional Craft Context
Which crafts or linguistic communities would benefit most? (e.g. Madhubani painters in Bihar, Channapatna toy makers in Karnataka).

### 📋 Additional Context
Add any other context, wireframes, mockups, or screenshots.
